item.itunes:title: iPhone Duo暴力測試翻車？！轉軸卡死、螢幕綠線｜三星中階手機也能AirDrop｜觸控MacBook曝光
item.itunes:author: 3cTim哥生活日常
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZLDrBr-L3k4

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握三星中階手機支援 Apple AirDrop 的跨系統傳輸突破與適用機型。
  • 搶先了解配備 M5 晶片與觸控螢幕的全新 MacBook Pro 四大升級亮點。
  • 深入探究備受矚目的摺疊 iPhone 在極限耐用度測試中的實測表現與鉸鏈弱點。

摘要

三星 Quick Share 跨平台功能下放中階 A 系列

作者指出，三星自今年三月起讓內建的 Quick Share 直接支援蘋果的 AirDrop，實現與 iPhone、iPad 及 Mac 之間的無縫檔案傳輸。這項原先僅限於 Galaxy S 與 Z 系列旗艦機種的便利功能，近期已開始推送到部分 Galaxy A56 與 A57 使用者手中。在升級至 One UI 9.0 或更新版本後，使用者只要在設定中開啟「與 Apple 裝置分享」，無需額外安裝應用程式或掃描 QR Code 即可傳送照片與文件。

全新觸控螢幕 MacBook Pro 亮眼登場

作者接著分享，蘋果預計於美國時間 10 月 28 日舉行新品發表會，正式推出眾所期待的觸控螢幕 MacBook Pro。這款新機型將搭載強效的 M5 Pro 與 M5 Max 晶片，並具備大幅減輕機身重量、首度導入觸控螢幕、強化操作體驗的全新系統，以及告別螢幕瀏海設計等四大優勢。觸控螢幕定位為繪圖、標註與快速選取的輔助輸入方式，並非取代傳統鍵盤與觸控板。

摺疊 iPhone 極限耐用度殘酷實測

最後，作者介紹了知名科技頻道針對摺疊 iPhone 展開的極限耐用度考驗。實測項目包含刀片刮痕、打火機灼燒、大量細沙掩埋與反向徒手彎折。雖然機身標榜具備最高等級的 IP68 防塵防水能力，但在沙塵測試後，細小的沙粒依然滲入了鉸鏈縫隙與軸承內部，引發機械結構卡死而無法完全閉合，最終在反向彎折測試中遺憾宣告損毀。

================================================

Hello everyone, today is October 28th, let's take a look at today's top three tech news stories. >> This video is sponsored by Jiesheng Communication. First, since March of this year, Samsung has enabled its built-in Quick Share feature to directly support Apple’s AirDrop, allowing seamless file transfers with iPhones, iPads, and Macs. Previously limited to the Galaxy S and Z series flagships, this convenient feature has finally expanded to the mid-range Galaxy A series, making it no longer exclusive to premium models. Samsung's.

A series is now compatible with Apple's AirDrop, with media reports confirming that Samsung has recently rolled out this cross-platform sharing feature to some Galaxy A56 and A57 users. On One UI 9.0 and later, the Quick Share settings include a new "Share with Apple devices" option, allowing you to send photos, videos, and documents to iPhones without needing extra apps or QR codes. However, only the Galaxy A56.

and A57 currently support this. Will Samsung expand this to more mid-range models? That remains to be seen pending an official announcement. Moving on to the second story. Apple is expected to hold a product launch event on October 28th, US time, to officially introduce the highly anticipated touchscreen MacBook Pro. According to recent reports, while the new touchscreen MacBook Pro will feature M5 Pro and M5.

Max chips, it offers four key advantages over current models: significant weight reduction, the first-ever implementation of a touchscreen, and a new system to enhance the user experience. The touchscreen is primarily positioned as an auxiliary input method, providing more flexibility for drawing, annotation, and quick selection, rather than replacing the trackpad or keyboard . Finally, it will say goodbye to the notch design. Lastly, let's look at a tech channel famous for its "durability.

tests," which put the iPhone Fold through a series of rigorous endurance trials. The tests included scratching the surface, burning the screen with a lighter, covering it with large amounts of sand, and attempting to bend the phone by hand in the opposite direction . Unfortunately, the iPhone Fold didn't survive the bend test; it ultimately failed because sand got stuck in the hinge mechanism. As for the iPhone, its performance in the scratch and screen tests is similar to most foldable phones. Regarding dust resistance and.

bending tests, the iPhone highlights its IP68 dust-proof rating, where the IP6X represents the highest level of dust protection, which should theoretically prevent dust from entering the device's internal components under standard testing conditions. However, after the test, when the phone was covered in sand, the particles still managed to enter the hinge crevices and bearing gaps, causing the hinge to jam and preventing.

the phone from closing properly, leading up to the final extreme bending test.

=============
